name: wappie
description: Read-only access to your WhatsApp archive in Wappie: authorized numbers, chats, message metadata and activity.

interface.longDescription: Wappie archives the WhatsApp numbers you connect to it and stores their content encrypted. This plugin lets your assistant read that archive through Wappie's hosted connector, after you sign in to the Wappie console and choose which numbers it may read. It is read-only: it cannot write, post, reply, delete or change anything, and it never marks a message as read. The hosted connector holds no key to open message content, so the assistant sees who, when, how much and what type of message, never the text, names or filenames. Wappie is an independent product of The Happie Co and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta.
defaultPrompt: Using Wappie, summarize today's WhatsApp activity on my numbers.
